chapters.label: The first goal, live
chapters.text: Budapest, 2019. Lyon play Barcelona in the Women's Champions League final. Van de Sanden races clear, crosses low... Ada Hegerberg slides it under the keeper!

chapters.label: Hat-trick
chapters.text: Five minutes later, Majri slips it across. Left foot, two! Then Bronze whips it in. A hat-trick before the half-hour!

chapters.label: The run
chapters.text: Watch it again. Ada waits by her defender. A split second before the cross, she darts in front. Too late to follow!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Move a split second before the cross, not after. Dart to the near post, and your defender cannot follow.
